[quote=irakqaist;61081659][i][u][b]Irakqaist Signal Hijacking on United Lavian Republic([nation]Lavinsworth United Islands[/nation])and [nation]Mizrahel[/nation][/b]

25 July 2027, 09:08 AM
[/u]
Unexpectedly, TV screens, public displays, and emergency broadcast stations throughout the United Lavian Republic and Mizrahel lost all signal and broadcasted a single message. The symbol of the Isaath Government dominated the screens as videos of the Irakqaast missile forces, tanks, and launch teams stood at the ready. The sound of music (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RPdyos0GfE8&list=RDRPdyos0GfE8&start_radio=1) accompanied the digital burning of the flags of the United Lavian Republic and Mizrahel as a voice chanted that the two countries were the Shaytan of Shamat.

The message stated the Isa'ath Government will not accept the term colonial occupation in Shamat. The ULR as well as Mizrahel were accused by the message of theft, defilement, and oppression, as the message refers to this conflict as a battle involving their very values and not merely an issue in their political arena.

Just seconds after the hijacking concluded, the government of Irakqaist broadcasted a direct statement from President Saldian Hussein. President Hussein, standing behind the Presidential Seal, proclaimed responsibility for the signal intrusion and transformed the threat from a warning to an ultimatum. Hussein asserted that unless the United Lavian Republic and Mizrahel relinquish control and release the land of Shamat from bondage, the strategic missile attacks would target objectives to restore justice by force. He asserted that all avenues of diplomacy were over and that resistance is an assault upon the Isaath people.
[/i][/quote]

[quote=the_crystalline_empire;61049522][b]July 1, 2027: The Kianzhou Sea and New Balion[/b]

Rosenmarkke did not usually pay attention to the affairs of the countries on the Kianzhou sea, the Daesunite Thawne Doctrine prevented that and permitted Daesunite hegemony over the region. However, while the government and general populace didnt pay attention beyond news feeds and reports, the SCSID kept a keen eye on affairs in that region.

It was thus that when war broke out earlier in 2027 between the Argossian state of New Balion (a middling Imperial claimant state) and the state of Daesun (the hegemon of Kianzhou and keystone nation for the Thawne Doctrine, and an ally of the EDU) the SCSID quietly began to collect data on the conflict.

The data was troublsome, a clearly unprepared guerilla state was going against Kianzhous most powerful economic and military state, and it showed in the foolhardy moves that New Balion had taken. 

However, when reports came from the SCSIDs southern command that a potential attempt at sending biological weapons to Daesun had been made by alleged non-state, neutral actors the SCSID command began to devise a plan to potentially begin actions against New Balion.

After about a week of planning, meetings, and discussions, a plan would be presented to the Triumvirate for their approval. The goal, assassinate the Emperor of New Balion.

Assassination! Cried Consul Phillipe Belgarde, That is unprecedented, anan uncharted territory for Rosenmarkke, gasped the consul in slight shock upon recieving the full plan from General Menkins.

I would agree with Mr. Belgarde here, however, given the intel you have presented to us, it seems a necessary evil, stated the Chief Consul 

Will it be quiet? Enquired Polenne Strømm.

Yes madame consul, the SCSID has a two month infiltration plan to end the Emperor, already a few tourists and journalists are on their way, replied General Menkins.

Very well then, does the PDC know? Enquired the Chief Consul.

Yes, they were briefed on the matter, replied Menkins.

As long as it is quiet and successful I have no issue, but if this gets out, your position is in danger, replied the chief consul. 

Menkins nodded and then bowed before heading out, this was the SCSIDs first attempt at an international assassination, and a high profile one at that.

Following the triumvirates approval, six inconspicuous individuals vetted by the SCSID and three SCSID operatives were dispatched to the capital of New Balion to begin to normalise their presence in the city, however, with a two month deadline, the normalization had to be quick. Three of the individuals would apply for palace positions under the staff, another with diplomatic experience applied for a position within the government, the others were points of contact for SCSID high command
-___

[i]The population of Elyserians who are not of the original Llyndorran stock which Balionic peoples hail from are around an eigth of the total population of the Empire. With those who are of Rossenmarkkian origin, the number is around 300k who are mostly concentrated on the dense port cities of the Southern Mainland, especially in the 2nd largest city of Trademinister. Many of them are usually recent immigrants who were brought to the land via the recent international appeal from the Empire for more people, especially of Elyserian origin, to come and settle the vast Empire. They either worked within the various shipyards and ports of the Empire, or within middle class professions which a few lucky ones where able to make their way to the grand capital of the Empire, Tandon. [/i]

Due to the expansion of the state, there was a renewal for recruitment for positions within the Government of the Empire. This was especially the case for positions related to the Nobility and the Emperor himself, who's estate expanded to more palaces, gardens and the latest pleasure ship, HMS Heffner. The positions of the new estates for the Emperor were very popular with over 15 thousand people applying for 1,256 positions. While most of these applicants were Balionic citizens, a few were either of foreign origin of nationality, which around 10 of whom were Rossenmarkkians. Unbeknown to the Empire, three of the applicants were actually spies of the SCSID of Rossenmarkke who were at first able to go undetected by the Royal Internal Security Agency (RISA) and managed to find positions across the Emperor's new estate. One of them, as able to find work as a golf caddy at the Emperor's new palace of "Regency Palace" in the north eastern city of Lost Heaven. The other two found new jobs as janitors/cleaning crew aboard the pleasure ship, the ultra-luxury ocean liner HMS Heffner, who's maiden voyage was about to begin in a weeks time from Pier 59 in Trademinister which would be attended by high level nobility, business magnates and potential Emperor Augustus X himself.

The foreign office expanded too. However, to maintain the element of homogeneity and the strict elitism of the office, they were only open to Balionics who were at least of Upper-Middle-Class origin and had connections to the nobility. If the applicant did not meet those unspoken requirements, they were either recruited for other means such as translators or were part of security staff and other low level positions. A sole Rossenmarkkian who claimed to have great experience in the field of international relations tried to apply, and for the positions he could apply for and his background aroused suspicion. RISA swooped in quickly to arrest the individual and take him to the giant mega prison facility of HMP Fox in the middle of the Empire for interrogation. HMP Fox is a major prison, who's prisoners range from low-security convicts who committed low level crimes, to maximum security sections for the most serious offenders such as drug dealers, serial killers, mafia bosses and Adamites. It holds a whopping 45 thousand prisoners with capcity for 50k. It also had wards for psyche patients, witness protection prisoners, large rooms for wealthy/influencial prisoners, POW camps and a holding section for RISA suspects which this Rossenmarkkian citizen was held.

An elite RISA agent Ralph Stock also known as "Agent Double 69" approaches the Rossenmarkkian and begins to question him, first asking;

"You know full well that foreign nationals like yourself, especially with vast experience as yours cannot become officials in the foreign office. Why did you decide to join?"

[nation]Shahzada[/nation] RP

[spoiler=[i]Astors Federation of Automakers of Stock Car Auto Racing.[/i]]

[i]FASCAR, a Stock Car League, started by the Astor Motor Company, which needed to branch out, it already got processed through the system, via a Government Deal, Imerria would Sell Uranium to Ascoiya via Debswana, a Botshukudan-based mining corporation the Imerrian Govt. hired to mine the Uranium, all asked that Astor was to be accepted into the Ascoiyan Market.

Astor already had contacts, deals, contracts written, much legalese had been translated, but after the Ascoyians accepted the Imerrian Offer, Astor bought large empty facilities, storages facilities, and more, but they realized one little problem, how would they stand out? Besides being, That one foreign car company.

Racing. Racing is the heart and soul of Imerria, Christ being its faith, racing is so widespread its a national pastime to go to the Go-Kart track and go racing, its far more popular than Football or Rugby, atleast in Imerria, and so FASCAR was proposed by Chief Marketing Officer Alan Sterling.

FASCAR would take place in 19 weeks, 19 tracks, some road courses, some ovals, all cars would be stock cars, ones you could find on the road, just with weight taken out, and juiced up to make as much as power as possible for racing.

The first FASCAR season will entirely take place in Ascoiya, with Car Models being the Lagonda Sailor and the Astor War Horse, with 20 teams, 40 racers, theyll have to pick their cars now.

A marketing campaign will have started by now, only thing thats left is to invite Ascoiyan Automakers and start those engines, and by the seasons end, theyll have made their name or this would have been a huge money pit, only one way to find out.[/i][/spoiler]

[Spoiler= war on home territory]
[u]includes several pov's[/u]
[B]08:34[/b]
[I]the platoon waiting near the bridge look at the distant explosions and turn on the radio. The news is nothing but endless reports of Nueue strikes on home territory until a morse signal goes through.
2 shorts 1 long.
The platoon recognizes the signal. It's time to start
Immediately a few soldiers attach the first naval mine to the bridge, lift it and toss it over the bridge until 13 mines are 2 meter under water hanging from a bridge. Their job is done for now.[/i] 

[I]elsewhere a surface-to-air missile truck is hidden between vegetation waiting for any unfortunate plane to cross its path. Eventually the commander spots a plane on the radar.
"Growler, Turn on home-on-jam!"
The gunner acknowledges and HOJ mode gets turned on, now treating the growler's many electronic distractions as merely a beacon. The SAM unit waits until the growler gets close. 1 missile gets fired and flies straight to the growler, detonating besides it and downing it. The SAM launcher then quickly relocates to an other location to prevent getting striked.[/i] 

[I]across the country regiments and battalions start building trenches and concealing them to blend in with the landscape. At the coast several battalions launch dozens of cheap drones that mimick attack drones. The drones fly towards the HDF fleet and a few engineers watch as several ships try to take down the fake drones[/i] 

[B]Zuidhoven, same time[/b]
[I]major Klaas vuylsteke of the ground army hurried through the corridors of the nearly empty army HQ. He flinches slightly as another missile from the HDF strikes nearby. he walks downstairs to a heavily reinforced bunker and opens the door to see a few other officers who haven't relocated yet. Klaas sits down and starts to speak, "Well...what are our losses?." A few other officers mumble and discuss among themselves until a younger officer speaks up, "we lost a few command centers, a small few of those were decoys, some airfields are heavily damaged and we lost a few planes and some ships on sea but we sunk 2 HDF supply ships. The rest of HDF strikes are in a more detailed document that is almost finished. Thankfully we confirmed that HVLMS Vespurië wasn't sunk. But there is no trace of her, no radio, nothing. Our intelligence says that the HDF also has no idea. The ship just dissappeared. No trace left."
An older officer responds, "Our comms are constantly getting jammed. How do we solve that?" Another officer, this time from the navy looks up, "i got an idea. We will use field telephones for short-medium communication. The growlers can jam elekctromagnetic waves that go through the sky but can't jam them if they go through physical copper wires. That way the jammers are a lot more useless!" Klaas looks at the officer and says, "that seems like a good idea. Copper won't be a problem." Klaas looks at the NCO and says, "tell the engineer battalions to keep planning command center decoys around the country. It must perfectly mimick real ones. And recruit more conscripts. Atleast 70.000 and hold them in reserve." The NCO quickly leaves to deliver the message. 

Klaas sighs and says, "how is the goverment standing around?" Everyone in the room becomes silent and a low-ranking diplomat responds, "well...we have no idea where the ministers went. We estimate that the prime minister, ministers and a few ultranationalist officers are already out the country in unclaimed territory." 

A lieutenant-colonel waves his hand and says,
"i have a plan. How about we fully dissolve the central HQ for the time and fully decentralize the army. That way the army can't be knocked out in 1 strike. But we will keep limited contact in case of an emergency" Everyone in the room starts to think and discuss the proposal. 2 officers at the back then reply, "that sounds pretty decent. But how will they communicate with eachother?"
"The closest battalions and regiments can work together instead of a nationwide communication server." Klaas replied. 

After a few minutes of debate the majority of officers accept the proposal and one captain then blocks the door, "wait, i have a plan."
Officer 1: "what plan do you have?" The captain grabs a document and slides it on the table, "it's daring and high risk and planning, scouting and paying informants will take long but the results will be worth it."
Officer 2: "what are the details?"
Captain: "that is classified but all i can say is that no one will see it coming. Planning is already starting at an undisclosed location and absolute secrecy is required. All i ask for is if the intelligence service can borrow the 1th and 2nd special foreign regiments for the time being."
Klaas looks at the captain and responds, "sure."
The diplomat from earlier then says, "i can look into this and see what NeuDresden demands are for an end to this war. Try to hold out against any attacks until i get a reply back." With that the diplomat leaves and everyone else in the room quickly leaves back to their own regiments and divisions. Several soldiers install in the front lobby several electronic devices that mimick a local command center. Once they are installed the platoon leaves the building on their way to install the next decoy.[/i] 

[B]39 kilometers east from zuidhoven[/b]
[I]a squadron of F-14AN's, divided over three flights, are currently flying at low altitude searching for reconaissance planes, J-15's or EA-18G's. Flight A leader Nicolas look up searching for any traces of a fighter and soon spots a small flight of EA-18G's and J-15's, Nicolas turns on his radio and says, "enemy flight above. Turn on HOJ mode." The pilots turn on HOJ mode on their missiles and pull up, once closer they fire their missiles and the missiles, with HOJ mode on, ignore the decoys the growler sends out and explode under or besides the planes, most planes in the enemy group go down while 2 J-15's try to escape the ambush but 3 planes from flight C intercept them and take them down in a few seconds.
"Good job everyone, let's go" Nicolas and the rest quickly disperse and fly off to hidden airfields they are stationed at. That is the tactic. Fly defensively, lay in ambush, take down reconnaissance planes and growlers and avoid confrontation with the more advanced planes.[/i] 

[B]Near the entrance of the Jacob canal[/b]
[I]it was a boring day for the crew of coastal artillery 280-5. Their only job is to shoot any enemy submarines or ships that try to enter the jacob canal and today seems like that finally will happen.
Sammy, one of the spotters is standing outside with binoculars in hand and scans the horizon. He glances at his watch, 10 minutes until spotter duty rotates to another soldier. He looks back up and sees a Donau-class submarine surfacing to fire off another batch of missiles inland. He pulls the lever besides him and the alarm sounds. Immediately every soldier assigned to 280-5 runs into the turret and starts rotating to the submarine which has already started to fire its missiles, the camouflage that covers the turret starts to fall off because of the rotation. Inside it's a mess of commands and 280mm guided shells loading into the 2 cannons.
"Fire!"
2 shells fly out the cannons and towards the submarine.
One lands besides the submarine,
The second one hits it on top of the bow and causes catastrophic damage. The submarine starts sinking and a few minutes later it lays on the bottom of the canal. 

[B]foreign ministry 
Time: 16:07[/b]
The diplomat from earlier (oliver) is walking through the silent halls, Oliver arrives in the main correspondence room and calls Klaas.
Klaas picks up and says, "who's calling?"
"It's me, Oliver. NeuDresden demands unconditional surrender." Klaas sighs and says, "no way we will surrender until we know their plans after the war." Oliver looks at a message besides him and responds, "i got a message from Metropolis and they want to invite us, Luscaria and NeuDresden to negiotiate about in their words a stable and sustainable peace."
Klaas writes something down and replies, "telegram Metropolis and tell them we will accept their invitation."
Oliver ends the call and starts sending the message to Groldonica via radio.[/i][/spoiler]
